entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I… I need to return something. It's a VeloBand I bought last month.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Maria Flores, and the order was... VF67B891.

Thank you, Maria. I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse GPS tracker. It looks like it was delivered on December 27th. To best help you, could I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It just... it wasn't for me. I was hoping to return it and get my money back. Things are a bit tight right now.

I understand. I'm pulling up the return information now. Okay, Maria, I see here that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific return window. Unfortunately, looking at the delivery date, it is now too late to process a return for a refund.
Too late? But I thought VeloFit had a 10-day policy? I've been a loyal customer for years, I've always loved that about you guys.

I appreciate your loyalty, and you're right that our apparel has a 10-day policy. However, for wearable electronics like the VeloBand Pulse, our return policy is 10 days from the date of delivery. We have to be very strict with that timeline.
Ten days? Oh, no. I had no idea. With the holidays and everything, I just didn't get to it. I honestly really needed that money back. Is there truly nothing you can do?

I'm very sorry, but the policy is firm on this item. The main reason is for customer safety and hygiene. Once a wearable device like this has been out of our controlled environment for that long, we cannot accept it back due to sanitation protocols.
But I barely wore it. It's perfectly clean, I promise. I just feel so silly for waiting. I feel like I just threw money away that I don't have.

I understand your position, Maria, but we cannot make exceptions to the health and safety policy. It's a matter of bio-contaminant risk and we can't restock the item. It's simply too late. What I can suggest, and what many customers find helpful, is our official Resale Marketplace. You can often sell a lightly used device there for a very good price.
So I have to sell it myself? I just... I was hoping VeloFit would help me out. I'm just so disappointed.

I know this isn't the outcome you were hoping for, and I'm sorry for that. The Marketplace is the only path forward once the 10-day hygiene window has passed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No... I guess not. Thanks for your time.
